capabilities: Hide text between || markers or a custom marker
Reveal hidden text by clicking or hovering
Choose among particle, block, blur, scramble, and matrix styles
Wrap selected text via ribbon icon or Insert spoiler command
Tune per-style options like density, speed, color, and blur amount
disambiguation: Not limited to particle effects despite the name; it also offers block, blur, scramble, and matrix styles.
extras: Provides manual installation instructions only; announced upcoming features include a bulk-reveal command and per-note style customization via cssclasses.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to hide sensitive text, answers, or plot spoilers inside a note until the reader chooses to reveal them.
summary: Spoiler plugin that hides text wrapped in ||double vertical bars|| under one of five reveal-on-click visual effects.
